text:
vp-eng: Thanks everyone — quick live thread to capture remaining runtime Qs from today's all-hands. I'll answer the ones I can and loop in leads. Drop short bullets or links.

ana: Is there a concrete timeline for kernel v5 optimizations landing in dedicated clusters?

vp-eng: Short answer: staged rollout over 6 weeks. Planning: canary on 2 clusters week 1-2, ramp to 25% capacity week 3-4, full flip week 6 if no regressions.

liam: What are the primary regressions we're watching for during canary? specific metrics?

vp-eng: Latency P99, tail CPU spikes during autoregressive bursts, and token throughput under mixed sequence lengths. We also watch KV cache hit-rate and memory pressure.

maya: For teams tuning batching, any recommended starting presets? our app sees many short seqs (~32 tokens).

samir: For short sequences we recommend: max_batch_size=64, target_batch_latency_ms=12, and enable prefix_caching=true. We'll publish a small presets doc.

devex: Could we get a one-liner config snippet we can paste?

samir: Sure — sample:
```json
{
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 64, "target_latency_ms": 12},
  "caching": {"prefix_cache": true, "eviction_policy": "lru"}
}
```

ana: How aggressive will eviction be for prefix cache with multimodal workloads?

ops-sre: Default LRU cap is 24GB on our standard pool. For multimodal we surface adaptive eviction where shorter kv entries have lower cost. We'll add an opt-in flag this quarter.

liam: Any changes to autoscaler heuristics in this rollout? ramp policies?

vp-eng: Yes — autoscaler v2 uses weighted QPS and queue latency rather than only GPU utilization. Should reduce over-provisioning for spiky traffic. We'll ship as opt-in behind `autoscaler:v2` first.

maya: Can we get a clear rollback signal if P99 regresses post-rollout? thresholds?

vp-eng: Rollback triggers: sustained P99 increase > 10% for 10 minutes OR error rate spike > 0.5% for 5 minutes. Rollbacks are automatic for hosted; Dedicated customers will be notified and can choose revert.

ana: Who owns the telemetry dashboards for kernel v5? want to add a custom panel for prefix hit rate.

devex: @ana — I'll share a dashboard template (Grafana) and a short guide for adding panels.

eng-runtime-bot: NOTE: kernel-v5-canary deployed to cluster-east-2 at 2024-07-12T15:30Z (RWF-842).

samir: For people running private deployments: kernel v5 includes a new sequence-length aware kernel selector. Expect 6-12% CPU reduction on variable-length workloads. Quantization improvements also help on A100/MI250.

liam: Does quantized path change output determinism? we rely on stable outputs for eval.

samir: Quantized path is deterministic within the same binary+config, but small numeric diffs are possible vs fp16. We recommend running eval suites in staging with `quantize=true` before switching prod.

maya: Any docs or checklist for teams to validate before switching to v5?

devex: Yes — short checklist: 1) smoke test with 1000 requests, 2) run eval prompt set, 3) compare P99/latency and embedding similarity, 4) monitor KV hit-rate. I'll post the checklist link here in a follow-up.

ana: Appreciate it. One last ask: can leadership publish a terse roadmap milestone list (3 bullets) that PMs can copy into status decks?

vp-eng: Will do. TL;DR bullets I'll push to #announcements: week1 canary, week4 25% ramp, week6 GA. Will include key rollback thresholds and opt-in flags.

eng-runtime-bot: ACTION: vp-eng created follow-up doc: https://redwood.docs/internal/runtime/kernel-v5-rollout (internal).

samir: Ping me if you want early access to dedicated canaries — we can carve out a slot. :thumbsup:

liam: Thanks all — short and actionable.

vp-eng: Great thread. If anyone has specific stack traces or reproducible perf diffs, DM me or drop in #eng-runtime and tag @samir. Closing thread in 24h unless new asks. :sparkles:
